description: Reddit’s own suggested bid for a given objective, bid type and targeting — a median, a sensible range, and the hard floor below which Reddit will not accept a bid. Amounts come back in the ad account’s currency. Free, creates nothing. Use it to pick bidAmount for create_reddit_ads_ad_group instead of guessing a number that either never wins an auction or overpays.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

bidType.description: default CPC — must fit the campaign objective

budget.description: budget in the ad account’s currency

currency.description: currency code, e.g. USD; returned amounts use the ad account currency

endTime.description: ISO 8601 end of the flight to price

startTime.description: ISO 8601 start of the flight to price

targeting.description: targeting block, same shape as create_reddit_ads_ad_group targeting

name: reddit_ads_bid_suggestion
title: Ask Reddit what to bid
